sections.content: Modern forms include datalist autocomplete, output elements, and the :invalid/:valid CSS states for live feedback. The FormData API reads submissions in JavaScript.
Pattern attributes validate formats (emails, codes), min/max constrain numbers, and formaction overrides per-button.
Key points: never trust client validation alone — always validate server-side too, and use autocomplete attributes so browsers can fill correctly.
Summary: HTML5 Forms Advanced — practice the example by changing values and predicting the output before running it.
